# Ollasync

> Meet beyond language. Video meetings and live training with live translated voice and captions.

Ollasync offers cloud SaaS for learning and multilingual meetings, and dedicated hosted deployments for regulated organizations. Published meeting plans support up to 100 participants; confirm deployment and plan details with the team. Translation supports 19 languages and up to five selected languages in a meeting. Participants can save a local recording on their device; eligible hosts can separately use cloud recording and AI notes from recorded meetings. Local recording does not mean every data flow or transcription stays on-device. End-to-end encrypted meetings do not offer live translation, cloud recording, or AI notes.
